qna.question: What are the shipping options?
qna.answer: We offer Standard (2-5 business days), Pls Shop new products on Products tab!

qna.question: What is your return policy?
qna.answer: We have an easy return and exchange policy within 7 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in original packaging. Refunds are processed within 3-5 business days.

qna.question: How can I track my order?
qna.answer: You can track your order from the 'My Orders' section in your account. You'll also receive a tracking email once your order ships.

qna.question: What payment methods do you accept?
qna.answer: We accept Credit Cards, Debit Cards, UPI, Net Banking, and Cash on Delivery (COD) on eligible products.

qna.question: How do I cancel an order?
qna.answer: You can cancel your order from the 'My Orders' section before it has been shipped. Once shipped, you'll need to initiate a return instead.

qna.question: How do I create an account?
qna.answer: Click on the 'Sign Up' button at the top right corner of the page. Fill in your details and you're good to go!

qna.question: I forgot my password. What do I do?
qna.answer: Click on 'Forgot Password' on the login page. We'll send a reset link to your registered email address.

qna.question: Do you have any discounts or offers?
qna.answer: Check our homepage banner for the latest deals! We regularly run seasonal sales and offer coupon codes via email to subscribers.

qna.question: How can I contact customer support?
qna.answer: You can reach us at support@eshop.com or call 1-800-ESHOP (1-800-374-67). Our support team is available Mon-Sat, 9 AM to 6 PM.

qna.question: How do I add items to my cart?
qna.answer: Simply click the 'Add to Cart' button on any product page. You can view your cart by clicking the cart icon in the navigation bar.

qna.answer: You're welcome! Is there anything else I can help you with?
